# Discord

> > Discord is a group chat platform combining voice, video, and text communication for gaming communities and social interaction.

Discord serves as a primary communication hub for gamers and communities worldwide, offering real-time chat, streaming capabilities, and social features. The platform also provides Discord Quests, an innovative advertising solution that enables gaming brands like Bethesda, Capcom, Blizzard, and entertainment partners like Universal Pictures, Paramount, and Netflix to engage users through rewarded video experiences.

## Key Topics

- Discord Quests
- group chat and voice communication
